Patchnote 2.2.6
This patch brings a big performance improvement, which should fix most of the issues faced until now.
We’re still trying to make the late game more challenging, while keeping a feeling of progression as you unlock bonuses.
Roguelite upgrades for HPs and Shield give less bonus
The Captain Pirate weaknesses are drastically nerfed

Some caravaneers were too slow to be a viable option in most cases. That’s why we choose to boost the Oniromancer & the Protector from 2 to 3 speed. The Hunter and the Swordman are boosted from 3 to 4 speed
We continue to reduce the drop rate of some items to make the inventory a little less crowdy. All valuable drop 30% less.
Some Fragments were not obtained at the right time in the main questline
Fix a softlock occurring sometimes after defeating the Dragonopterous caterpillar
Fix a softlock occurring sometimes at the beginning of a fight
The fight against the rebels in the “Princess Egg” quest was repeating itself.
The UI was sometimes disappearing after using an ability in exploration
Using food in the fight setup was causing a blocker
Blockers could occur after saving and quitting during a fight automatically triggered during a quest
Fix a blocker in the "Mushroom City" quest
Fixed a blocker on "Livewood City" quest, where the caravan couldn't reach the next quest objective
Helloooo everyone!
Long time no see! This patch comes with a long awaited addition: controller support!
You can finally play Sandwalker with your controller! Any input on a connected controller will switch the control mode automatically.
Monsters are now scaling stronger starting level 6, increasing fight difficulty in late game
Bosses rewards now scale with your Caravan’s level
Reputations now have less impact on shop prices
Various fixes on quests, removing some edge-case blockers and improving UX.
Custom controls should now be saved when you quit the game.
Bounty Hunters attacks weren’t working as intended.
Underground plants weren’t giving the right reward.
A Limuloid attack was giving Shield to its enemies.
The “Beast Lair” event wasn’t giving the expected trait in one of its choices.
Some upgrades weren’t working properly on the Swordman & the Protector.
Some Encyclopedia entries were missing, preventing players from completing the related Steam achievement.
And as always, probably other minor fixes that we forgot to mention.
It is probably the last major patch on Sandwalkers: thanks a lot for your feedback and support during the last few years!
We can’t wait to show you what will come next :)

Hi everyone!

The past two days have been intense as we tackled major balancing issues. Some players were able to finish the game in a single run, defeating all enemies in just one turn — not exactly what we had in mind for Sandwalkers!
This patch focuses on restoring challenge and progression. Here’s what’s new:
Enemy scaling fixed
Enemy groups were no longer scaling with your caravan, leading to easy fights against low-level (Lv.1) enemies. This is now fixed.
Unit encounter rework: We’ve restructured enemy groups to make encounters more varied and challenging:
2-enemy fights were too frequent and not engaging — most have been removed.
Stronger enemy groups have been added across all regions.
Each region now features more diverse enemy compositions.
More tweaks will follow — this is just the first step in our balancing effort.

notes.title: Caravaneer Upgrades Nerfed / Roguelite Bonuses Buffed

items.text: Sandwalkers isn’t about a single overpowered caravaneer dashing to Umama. It’s about generations building on each other’s journey.
Caravaneer upgrades nerfed by ~30%.
Cristal Library combat upgrades have been buffed to reinforce roguelite progression.
Protector
Gains +2 Strength/level (up from +1).
"Raise Shield" ability nerfed.
Status Effects
Decaying Shield buffed.
Infested nerfed.
Blinded nerfed.
Bosses & Elites
HP increased, but Strength reduced at levels 3–5.
All enemies
Strength reduced at levels 3–5, but increased from level 7 onward.
Merchants
Merchants in Cities now give more items
Fixed several attacks that dealt pure damage with no type.
"Ban Hammer" Fetish now correctly targets the launcher.
Rare black screen blocking progress.
Some units show the wrong sprite when stunned.
Bosses can be stunned, even when they should be immune.
Trade with merchants can be broken, allowing players to get insane amount of items

Thank you all for your patience and invaluable feedback — it really helped us identify and fix this core issue. There’s more to come, but this patch should make Sandwalkers feel closer to our original vision.
— The Sandwalkers Team
